name: IC Sensor — SPI — SSOP
description: Surface-mount IC sensor cluster featuring SPI communication in SSOP packages, including SSOP-16 and SSOP-20 footprint options.
selection_hints: Select when requiring an SMD sensor IC using an SPI interface in an SSOP package.
Choose between SSOP-16 (5.3x6.2mm, P0.65mm) and SSOP-20 (5.3x7.2mm, P0.65mm) footprint variants.
Use for tier A parts sourced from KiCad symbols including AS5045B and MAX31865xAP.
avoid_when: Do not use if the design requires a package family other than SSOP.
Avoid when non-SMD (through-hole) mounting is required.
Avoid if an interface other than SPI is required.
